knownIssues.symptom: The activation window never appears after Steam's CD key dialog
On DXVK the game hangs as a race starts with the sound looping (MoltenVK Internal Error 0000010d, then VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST)
In DXMT mode the window disappears when the game changes display mode

notes: The upstream record does not specify a renderer. DXMT is the starting default.
